section: Heriot Watt University Dubai: delivery challenges, outcomes and the continuing AVI-SPL partnership
body:
This part of the Heriot Watt University (HWU) case study covers how the campus AV project was coordinated, what the page reports as its impact, and what followed. It is useful as evidence of delivery on a multi-contractor education project and of on-site support after handover.

**The challenge**

The work had to be coordinated across multiple contractors, packages and systems. Some AV elements depended on external packages, so careful planning and communication were needed. AVI-SPL responded with detailed drawings, clear requirements and close collaboration with all stakeholders.

**Outcomes as reported on the page**

- Technology integration: a central control system with touch panels made the rooms easy to operate.
- Scalability: systems were designed to allow upgrades and expansion later.
- User experience: faculty and staff took to the systems, which the page says improved teaching and collaboration.
- Ongoing support: an on-site managed resource keeps operations running and troubleshoots quickly.

The outcomes are qualitative. The page gives no usage, uptime or satisfaction figures.

**What the customer said**

Anas Abu-Ghoush, Head of Information Services, said AVI-SPL's expertise and professionalism were clear from the start, that the team worked closely with the university to design and implement tailored audio-visual solutions for its classrooms and meeting spaces, and that it has provided valuable ongoing support. He called AVI-SPL a trusted partner as the university plans its future campus expansion.

**What came next**

According to the page, HWU invited AVI-SPL to design the AV solutions for its 2025 campus extension. The page states the invitation; it does not report that the extension was delivered. Ahmed Habib, Business Development Manager, described the project as an example of combining technology with an understanding of client needs to create environments for learning, collaboration and growth.

**When to use this**: questions about how AVI-SPL handles projects with many contractors, whether on-site support continued after an education deployment, or whether the customer came back for further work.
